name: voice-agent-inworld
description: Production-Ready Multilingual Realtime AI Chat Application Using Inworld AI

scripts.dev: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND" -c "blue,magenta" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix backend" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend"
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently -n "BACKEND,FRONTEND,ELECTRON" -c "blue,magenta,cyan" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix backend" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix frontend" "npm.cmd run dev --prefix desktop"
scripts.build: npm.cmd run build --prefix backend && npm.cmd run build --prefix frontend && npm.cmd run build --prefix desktop
scripts.install:all: npm.cmd install && npm.cmd install --prefix backend && npm.cmd install --prefix frontend && npm.cmd install --prefix desktop
